security_advisory.summary: PyArrow Use After Free in IPC reader with pre-buffering
security_advisory.description:
PyArrow prior to 23.0.1 contains a Use After Free vulnerability in the IPC file reader when pre-buffering is enabled. This can lead to memory corruption or crashes.

Upgrade from 20.0.0 → 23.0.1 is a MAJOR version bump (3 major versions). Known breaking changes:

**API changes to audit:**
- `pa.Table` / `pa.Array` constructor changes
- `pa.types` validation functions may have stricter behavior
- `pa.timestamp()` timezone handling changes
- `pyarrow.parquet` read/write API changes
- `ArrowException` hierarchy changes
- Deprecated APIs removed between 20.x and 23.x

**This codebase uses pyarrow extensively in:**
- `superset/result_set.py` — Core result set processing (pa.Table, pa.Array, pa.types)
- `superset/sqllab/utils.py` — SQL Lab result handling
- `superset/views/utils.py` — View utilities
- `superset/db_engine_specs/hive.py` — Hive engine with pyarrow.parquet
- `superset/commands/database/uploaders/columnar_reader.py` — Columnar file uploads
- `superset/semantic_layers/` — Semantic layer models and mappers

All usage sites must be audited for compatibility with pyarrow 23.x.
